templates.why_chosen: Medium-confidence, 11-component exemplar: a Host band of four send-queue boxes sits above the RNIC band, inside which an Event Mux core with four submodules (QPC, Schedule Policy, Schedule Queue) aggregates doorbell, credit and dequeue signals.
templates.what_to_learn: Place the caller band's repeated small boxes (four send queues here) in one row above the hardware band, then let a single mux-shaped core inside that band collect every event type by arrow direction alone rather than colour, so in and out of the core reads as the only code that matters.
